create_module: create an LLVM module with a given module ID string and global context
build_memory_buffer: build a memory buffer from the contents of a file at the specified filename
test_module_properties: test the module properties including data layout and target string accessors
iterate_functions: iterate over functions in an LLVM module in forward or reverse order
iterate_basic_blocks: iterate over basic blocks in an LLVM function in forward or reverse order
